title: Boosting Clear Cell Renal Carcinoma-Specific Drug Discovery Using a Deep Learning Algorithm and Single-Cell Analysis.
authors: Wang, Yishu; Chen, Xiaomin; Tang, Ningjun; Guo, Mengyao; Ai, Dongmei
one_liner_zh: 利用单细胞转录组和深度图神经网络筛选肾癌药物，虽涉及转录因子EPAS1但核心是药物发现而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Clear cell renal carcinoma (ccRCC), the most common subtype of renal cell carcinoma, has the high heterogeneity of a highly complex tumor microenvironment. Existing clinical intervention strategies, such as target therapy and immunotherapy, have failed to achieve good therapeutic effects. In this article, single-cell transcriptome sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from six patients downloaded from the GEO database were adopted to describe the tumor microenvironment (TME) of ccRCC, including its T cells, tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), endothelial cells (ECs), and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs). Based on the differential typing of the TME, we identified tumor cell-specific regulatory programs that are mediated by three key transcription factors (TFs), whilst the TF EPAS1/HIF-2alpha was identified via drug virtual screening through our analysis of ccRCC's protein structure. Then, a combined deep graph neural network and machine learning algorithm were used to select anti-ccRCC compounds from bioactive compound libraries, including the FDA-approved drug library, natural product library, and human endogenous metabolite compound library. Finally, five compounds were obtained, including two FDA-approved drugs (flufenamic acid and fludarabine), one endogenous metabolite, one immunology/inflammation-related compound, and one inhibitor of DNA methyltransferase (N4-methylcytidine, a cytosine nucleoside analogue that, like zebularine, has the mechanism of inhibiting DNA methyltransferase). Based on the tumor microenvironment characteristics of ccRCC, five ccRCC-specific compounds were identified, which would give direction of the clinical treatment for ccRCC patients.
abstract_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）是肾细胞癌中最常见的亚型，其肿瘤微环境高度复杂且具有高度异质性。现有的临床干预策略，如靶向治疗和免疫治疗，未能取得良好的治疗效果。本文利用从GEO数据库下载的六名患者的单细胞转录组测序（scRNA-seq）数据，描述了ccRCC的肿瘤微环境（TME），包括其T细胞、肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）、内皮细胞（ECs）和癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）。基于TME的差异分型，我们识别了由三个关键转录因子（TFs）介导的肿瘤细胞特异性调控程序，同时通过我们对ccRCC蛋白质结构的分析，利用药物虚拟筛选鉴定出转录因子EPAS1/HIF-2α。随后，结合深度图神经网络和机器学习算法，从生物活性化合物库中筛选抗ccRCC化合物，包括FDA批准的药物库、天然产物库和人类内源性代谢物化合物库。最终获得五种化合物，包括两种FDA批准的药物（氟芬那酸和氟达拉滨）、一种内源性代谢物、一种免疫/炎症相关化合物，以及一种DNA甲基转移酶抑制剂（N4-甲基胞苷，一种胞嘧啶核苷类似物，与泽布拉林类似，具有抑制DNA甲基转移酶的机制）。基于ccRCC的肿瘤微环境特征，我们鉴定出五种ccRCC特异性化合物，这将为ccRCC患者的临床治疗提供方向。
